about_the_game:
Welcome to the demo of "Scrap Bulwark Guide."

The main differences between the demo version (hereinafter referred to as the Demo) and the Early Access version are as follows:

    1. Number of Explorable Blocks: The Demo includes only 2 blocks, with no increase in danger levels (in the Early Access version, danger levels increase progressively).

    2. Initial Selectable Characters: The Demo offers 4 initial characters, with 3 needing to be unlocked through gameplay.

  • Daniel Wright, former SWAT assault team captain, a natural offensive commander skilled in formulating assault tactics and squad coordination. Able to precisely command team members to breach enemy defenses and achieve combat objectives at minimal cost.

  • Ryan Cooper, former military mechanical engineer, specializes in designing various lethal devices. Through ingenious engineering modifications, he can transform any shelter into a deadly fortress against invaders.

  • Hannah Scott, community self-defense force leader, excels in defense deployment and positional warfare. She skillfully utilizes terrain to direct the squad in establishing crossfire networks, serving as the team's strongest shield during horde sieges.

  • Zoe Mitchell, structural engineer, deeply knowledgeable in building mechanics and reinforcement techniques. Shelters modified by her are far superior to ordinary ones in structural strength and durability, capable of withstanding the most violent impacts.

    3. Types of Survivors: The Demo features only 5 types of survivors.

    4. Types of Buildings: The Demo includes just 12 types of buildings.

    5. Types of Enemies: The Demo features only 6 types of enemies.

    6. Types of Equipment: The Demo provides only 3 types of equipment.

Gameplay Introduction：

I. Exploring the Abandoned City
    The city lies in ruins. To survive, scour every corner - you never know what crucial resources you might find.

    1. Gathering Supplies
    Stockpile materials to build defenses and rescue survivors. Every scrap counts in your struggle for survival.

    2. Recruiting Survivors
    Find allies to help gather resources and fight off nightly zombie hordes. Many possess unique skills that could prove vital.

    3. Building Defenses
    Erect walls and install various turrets to protect your camp after dark. Adapt your designs to the environment for maximum effectiveness.

    4. Equipping Gear
    Search the city for scattered equipment. Only properly armed survivors can stand against the terrors of the night.

    5. Scouting New Districts
    Uncharted areas typically swarm with zombies. Prepare thoroughly before venturing into these dangerous zones.

    6. Advancing to New Territory
    When you've exhausted a district's resources, move your mobile base to the next area and begin anew.

II. Upgrading Your Mobile Base
    Enhance your vehicle with new equipment and modifications to gain tactical advantages.

III. Surviving the Night
    Daylight offers relative safety as zombies hide in the shadows. But when night falls, they emerge with terrifying aggression, attacking in coordinated waves.

IV. Strategic Evacuation
    Beyond the regular nightly assaults, periodic zombie tides threaten to overwhelm your defenses. Evacuate districts before these massive hordes arrive to ensure your group's survival.

short_description: "Scrap Bulwark Guide" is a tower defense game blending exploration and RPG mechanics. As a survivor in a post-apocalyptic city, you must recruit others, scavenge building materials from ruins, build street barricades, and fend off nightly zombie hordes to ultimately lead your group to safety.
